blocks.text: Sulfur aam taur par orbitals ke kamzor overlap ki wajah se doosre sulfur atoms ke saath double bonds ke bajaye single bonds banati hai. Nateejatan woh catenation se bare molecules aur banawatein banati hai: S8 taaj (crown) jaisa molecule hai (Figure 12.7). Yeh bonding, aur us ke compounds ki stability, kamre ke darja hararat par sulfur ki kam reactivity ki wajah hai.

blocks.alt: Aath peele sulfur atoms aik aise ring mein single S-S bonds se jure hain jo chapta nahi: atoms bari bari oopar neeche hain, chaar oopar ki teh mein aur chaar neeche ki, is liye molecule taaj (crown) jaisa lagta hai. Halki surmai rings dono tehon ko dikhati hain.
blocks.caption: Cyclo-octasulfur, S8 taaj-numa (crown) molecule (Figure 12.7 ke mutabiq asal 3D model; ghuma kar har taraf se dekhein).
blocks.long_description: Sulfur double bonds ke bajaye S-S single bonds pasand karta hai kyunke us ke orbitals pehlu ba pehlu (sideways) achha overlap nahi karte, is liye woh rings aur zanjeerein banata hai (catenation). S8 mein har sulfur do doosre sulfur se juda hai aur S-S-S zaviya taqreeban 108 degree hai; yeh zaviya aath atoms ke chapte ring mein nahi samata, is liye ring mud kar taaj ki shakal le leta hai.

fallback.text: S8: aath sulfur atoms S-S single bonds ke mure hue ring mein, bari bari oopar neeche, taaj ki shakal mein.
fallback.alt: 3D model ki tasveer: Cyclo-octasulfur, S8 taaj-numa (crown) molecule.

blocks.prompt: Kamre ke darja hararat par sulfur khasi ghair-reactive kyun hai (exercise Q.2g)?
blocks.explanation: Sulfur mazboot S-S single bonds se jure mustahkam S8 taaj halqon ke taur par maujood hai; kyunke 3p orbitals pehloo se kamzor overlap karte hain woh oxygen jaise reactive double bonds nahi banati. Halqe torne ko energy chahiye, to sulfur sirf garam karne par react karti hai, jaise jab woh jal kar SO2 banati hai.

items: Sulfur S-S single bonds ko tarjeeh deti hai (kamzor orbital overlap), halqon aur zanjeeron mein catenate hoti hai; S8 taaj jaisa molecule hai; is liye kamre ke darja hararat par kam reactivity.
